subject: english
stem: Claim: Clear shelf labels reduce time spent finding supplies. Which example best supports it?
options: After labels were added, students found art tools two minutes faster.
The labels were printed in black.
One shelf was made of wood.

optionRationales.reason: After labels were added, students found art tools two minutes faster.：有 label 處理與 finding time 降低。
The labels were printed in black.：無找尋時間結果。
Students bought more paint.：不同結果。
One shelf was made of wood.：無關。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 After labels were added, students found art tools two minutes faster.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 After labels were added, students found art tools two minutes faster. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
